Apple has released the fourth iOS 27 developer beta, build 23G71. iOS 27 beta 4 replaces the third beta from the prior two releases, continuing Apple's summer beta testing cycle ahead of the fall public launch. We'll be updating our devices and sharing what we find.

Apple releases fourth iOS 27 developer beta for testing

The fourth developer beta is now available through the Settings app on eligible iPhones. If you're signed up for the Apple Developer Program, head to Settings > General > Software Update > Beta Updates, then choose iOS 27 Developer Beta.

Apple released the first iOS 27 public beta on July 13. Today's release is expected to become iOS 27 public beta 2 next week. The final public version will roll out to all users this fall.

As with all developer betas, you should still expect bugs, reduced battery life, app compatibility issues, and other instability.

iOS 27 is all about Siri AI

iOS 27 is one of the most AI-packed iPhone updates Apple has released. The headline change is Siri AI, Apple's assistant rebuilt on a new generation of Apple Intelligence and brand-new Apple Foundation Models.

Siri AI delivers richer conversational experiences, personalized context, broader world knowledge, on-screen awareness, and deeper in-app actions across the system.

On iPhone, Siri AI also features a new visual experience integrated with Dynamic Island and a dedicated Siri App for browsing conversation history across devices.

Visual Intelligence joins the Siri lineup too, including a new Siri mode in the Camera app and related improvements to iPhone camera controls.

Apple Intelligence is also expanding to more apps. iOS 27 adds AI-powered improvements to Photos, Safari, Passwords, Mail, Messages, Phone, Shortcuts, and Home, among others. As we noted when we broke down Apple's new Foundation Models, some features run on-device while others execute via Private Cloud Compute.

Not every iOS 27 AI feature will work on every iPhone. iOS 27 itself supports iPhone 11 and later, as well as iPhone SE (2nd generation) or newer, but Siri AI requires newer Apple Intelligence-capable hardware. Apple's most powerful on-device AI models have even stricter hardware requirements, including iPhone 17 Pro and iPhone Air.

More features and changes in iOS 27

Beyond Siri and Apple Intelligence, iOS 27 includes a range of iPhone-specific changes. Apple has refined the Liquid Glass design introduced last year, including a new Liquid Glass transparency slider that lets users adjust the look of the system interface.

Performance improvements include faster app launches, photo loading, opening the camera in Low Power Mode, AirDrop transfers, and Wi-Fi to cellular network switching.

Other iPhone changes include keywords and star ratings in Photos, customizable slideshow playback, smoother camera operation, a continuous send feature in Messages, Dual Capture in FaceTime, custom EQ for AirPods, new recovery options, easier Apple Pay credit card switching, and AI-generated wallpaper creation.

We're currently installing iOS 27 beta 4 and will update with anything noteworthy we come across. In the meantime, you can also see all of iOS 27's new features in our Apple event hub.

Spot anything new in today's iOS 27 beta 4? Tell us in the comments below!
